name: Agriculture Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public agriculture data.

entries.title: AMIS Market Database
entries.description: The G20 Agricultural Market Information System's database of supply-and-demand balances for wheat, maize, rice, and soybeans across the principal trading countries, letting users compare estimates from the major sources side by side.
entries.publisher: Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS), Secretariat hosted by FAO

coverage.spatial: AMIS participating countries (principal producers and traders) and world totals

entries.license: unverified — no data license stated on the AMIS site; see the FAO Secretariat for reuse terms
entries.notes: Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 (redirects to /home). The site is JavaScript-rendered; headless Chromium shows the Market Monitor, a Market Database (Supply & Demand overview, Compare sources, Custom query at https://app.amis-outlook.org/#/market-database/...) and a Policy Database. The download format is assumed from the custom-query tool and should be confirmed by a steward. No license is stated, so none is claimed.

entries.title: FAOSTAT
entries.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization's global statistical database covering agricultural production, trade, land use, and food security for nearly every country and territory.
entries.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
entries.notes: Verified reachable this session (HTTP 200). Bulk downloads available via FAOSTAT's own bulk-download API in addition to the interactive browser. Seeded as this vertical's first international (non-US) source per operator request to seed the new verticals international-first.
